gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-cairo: Cairo reads smooth and modern. Bruno Ace SC is the showier one, its strokes holding a single thickness from stem to curve, while Cairo keeps its bowls wide open for quiet text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-cambay: Crossbars as fat as the stems they join mark Bruno Ace SC. Cambay, a contemporary sans-serif with rounds that gap open, takes over the text and lets the heading do the shouting.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-cantarell: Wide-set, confident, a bit sci-fi. Bruno Ace SC spreads its letters like beads on a thread, and Cantarell follows with pulled-apart c shapes and tidy arches, friendly enough to settle the page.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-catamaran: Bruno Ace SC draws every stroke at a single thickness, with open apertures and no thinning anywhere. Catamaran, loose and curvy in its sans-serif way, is the quality that softens the whole pairing.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Expressive from the first letter, Bruno Ace SC has stout strokes and spaced-out shapes that earn their place when big and short. And Chiron Hei HK, with its wide-open c, handles everything else.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-commissioner: Wide, open and a little futuristic. Commissioner keeps up as a smooth sans-serif with no clogged curves, each stroke drawn at one thickness beside Bruno Ace SC's distinctive spread.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-didact-gothic: Distinctive, spaced-out capitals up top. Didact Gothic sits beneath as a modern sans-serif that never snags on closed bowls, so Bruno Ace SC gets to be the showpiece while the text just flows.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 brings wide channels into each counter and a tube-like thickness through every bend. Give Bruno Ace SC the larger size.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-doto: Spread-out letters strung like beads, drawn with one fixed nib width: that's Bruno Ace SC. Doto, plain sans with generous mouths on its rounds, handles the quieter work.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-el-messiri: Clean and modern, with a moderate thick-thin ratio and a wide slot in the c. Bruno Ace SC is better at bold, unshaded display lines, while El Messiri handles mild, gently modulated text.
